environment.description: IoT gateway service running on ECS Fargate in us-east-1. The Split.io feature flag 'iot_legacy_hmac_verification' is set to treatment 'on' for all entities as part of a gradual migration from legacy devices that hasn't been completed. The RSA public key is accessible at the documented path. PyJWT version 1.7.1 installed (allows algorithm confusion). Service exposed via NLB on port 8443 with TLS termination.

config.network: NLB with public IP, port 8443 open
